gloss: natural manner; being oneself; natural stance

definitions.explanation: A relaxed, unforced way of behaving, without putting on airs or tensing up. Originally the natural upright stance in judo and kendo, and still used of that.

examples.japanese: {自然体|しぜんたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{話|はな}す→話す：00467_hanasu⟧。
examples.english: To speak naturally, without putting on airs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{面接|めんせつ}→面接：01100_mensetsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{自然体|しぜんたい}で⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧だ。
examples.english: In an interview, it is best to just be yourself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧になって⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{自然体|しぜんたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{気軽|きがる}→気軽：06865_kigaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{話|はな}しかける→話しかける：03134_hanashikakeru⟧。
examples.english: Even after becoming famous she has stayed natural and unaffected, and chats easily with anyone.

notes:
A word of praise: someone who is {自然体|しぜんたい} is relaxed and genuine, neither nervous nor showing off.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自然体|しぜんたい}で⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧: to be oneself
- {自然体|しぜんたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}む→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧: to face (a match, an exam) calmly, without tensing up
- {自然体|しぜんたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧: a natural smile
- {自然体|しぜんたい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生|い}きる→生きる：01184_ikiru⟧: to live true to oneself
